title.zh: 缺陷控制：表面平了也可能已经损伤
title.en: Defect control: a flat surface may already be damaged

subtitle.zh: Dishing / Erosion / 划伤/ 颗粒与腐蚀
subtitle.en: Dishing / erosion / scratches / particles and corrosion

body.zh: 平坦度合格，不代表缺陷、电性和可靠性同时合格
body.en: Passing planarity does not imply passing defects, electrical performance and reliability

body.zh: 缺陷控制流程；从检测到处置，闭环降低缺陷风险
body.en: Defect-control flow Close the loop from detection to action to reduce defect risk

body.zh: 缺陷检测；光学 /电学 /形貌
body.en: Defect inspection Optical / electrical / morphology

body.zh: 缺陷分类；形貌与特征识别
body.en: Defect classification Identify morphology and features

body.zh: 关联图形与位置；版图/ 密度/ 关键区
body.en: Correlate patterns and locations Layout / density / critical regions

body.zh: 对照设备耗材；机台/ 抛光垫/ 浆料
body.en: Compare equipment and consumables Tool / pad / slurry

body.zh: 根因验证；试验/ 数据比对
body.en: Root-cause validation Experiments / data comparison

body.zh: 控制处置；工艺优化/预防
body.en: Control actions Process optimization / prevention

body.zh: 关键缺陷类型与示意；不同缺陷形貌不同，成因不同，影响不同
body.en: Key defect types and illustrations Different morphology, causes and effects

body.zh: Dishing：宽金属区局部凹陷；宽金属线中心被过度去除；形成局部凹陷
body.en: Dishing: local depression in a wide-metal region Excessive removal at the center of a wide metal line creates local depression

body.zh: Erosion：高密度图形区整体介质损失；高密度图形区介质被整体去除；表面整体下沉
body.en: Erosion: overall dielectric loss in a dense-pattern region Dielectric is removed across a dense-pattern region and the overall surface subsides

body.zh: Scratch：硬颗粒或接触异常；形成划伤；由硬颗粒或接触异常；在表面形成线性划伤
body.en: Scratch: hard particles or abnormal contact produce scratches Hard particles or abnormal contact create linear surface scratches

body.zh: 颗粒与腐蚀：残留、清洗或；化学失衡；残留颗粒或化学失衡引起；颗粒与腐蚀斑
body.en: Particles and corrosion: residues, cleaning or chemical imbalance Residual particles or chemical imbalance create particle and corrosion spots

body.zh: 耦合关系：去除条件与缺陷风险；去除越强，效率越高，但缺陷风险也同步上升
body.en: Coupling: removal conditions and defect risk Stronger removal increases efficiency and also increases defect risk

body.zh: 增强去除条件；（更高压力/更激进工艺）
body.en: Stronger removal conditions (higher pressure / more aggressive process)

body.zh: 时间可能缩短；（效率提升）
body.en: Time may decrease (higher efficiency)

body.zh: 图形凹陷、介质损耗；和机械缺陷风险增加
body.en: Higher risk of pattern depression, dielectric loss and mechanical defects

body.zh: 影响边界；Dishing与Erosion；受版图密度、线宽、；材料堆叠和工艺窗口；共同影响
body.en: Boundary of impact Dishing and erosion are jointly influenced by pattern density, linewidth, material stack and process window together

body.zh: 常见信号 从量测结果中识别典型缺陷表现；宽线凹陷；（Dishing）
body.en: Common signals: identify characteristic defects in metrology Wide-line depression (dishing)

body.zh: 密集区下沉；（Erosion）
body.en: Dense-region subsidence (erosion)

body.zh: 随机划伤；（Scratch）
body.en: Random scratches (scratch)

body.zh: 颗粒或腐蚀斑；（Particles / Corrosion）
body.en: Particles or corrosion spots (particles / corrosion)

body.zh: 量测反馈：缺陷map / 表面轮廓 / 显微与截面 / 电性；缺陷map；（位置与分布）
body.en: Metrology feedback: defect map / surface profile / microscopy and cross-section / electrical Defect map (location and distribution)

body.zh: 表面轮廓；（形貌/深度）
body.en: Surface profile (morphology / depth)

body.zh: 显微与截面；（形貌/成分）
body.en: Microscopy and cross-section (morphology / composition)

body.zh: 电性；（电学性能）
body.en: Electrical (electrical performance)

body.zh: 下游影响；缺陷可能在后续工艺与产品中放大，造成电性与可靠性问题
body.en: Downstream effects Defects may amplify in subsequent processing and products, causing electrical and reliability issues

body.zh: 短路；（Short）；开路；（Open）；电阻漂移；（RC偏移）；漏电；（Leakage）；可靠性风险；（良率与寿命下降）
body.en: Short (short) Open (open) Resistance drift (RC shift) Leakage (leakage) Reliability risk (lower yield and lifetime)
